text: Machine learning is a part of artificial intelligence that allows computers to learn from data. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model. A model is like a set of rules that helps the computer make predictions about new information. For example, a model can predict whether an email is spam or not. After training, we can test the model to see how good it is. Accuracy shows how often the model's predictions are correct. The higher the accuracy, the better the model works.
